name: ValidatedVmSpec

test_list.description: A VM cannot be admitted with a zero disk size or zero lifetime.
Ingress accepts explicit operator IP addresses only and requires mTLS.
An empty allowlist or absent mTLS requirement is rejected.
Unspecified, multicast, and broadcast IPv4/IPv6 addresses are rejected.
IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses normalize to the equivalent IPv4 address and duplicates collapse.
An allowlist above the documented fixed maximum is rejected.
The idle timeout is positive and bounded by the hard lifetime.

inputs.name: disk_gib
inputs.description: Requested boot disk size in GiB.

inputs.name: ingress
inputs.description: Exact operator IP allowlist and mandatory mTLS flag.

output_description: An immutable validated policy configuration or a typed validation error.
